name: Export Data to CSV
description: Learn how to export system data to CSV format for external analysis

steps.title: Navigate to Data View
steps.description: Go to the data section where you want to export information from.

steps.title: Apply Filters
steps.description: Set any filters or date ranges to narrow down the data you want to export.

steps.title: Click Export Button
steps.description: Locate and click the Export or Download button, usually found in the toolbar.

steps.title: Select CSV Format
steps.description: Choose CSV as the export format from the available options.

steps.title: Download File
steps.description: Click the Download button to save the CSV file to your computer.
